name: Wildkin E'ko
label: Quest
description: Wildkin E'ko: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: In Winterspring, you will fight creatures of might dat seem to possess an innate magic ability. These wildkin can use strong magics. If you wish ta gain an increase in your intellect bring me da E'ko you find from any a' da owlbeasts you find der.
Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mau'ari can derive da juju for friend... Use da Cache of Mau'ari to cast dis upon yourself or your allies.
